title: Add one XState machine to a Tau project
description: Adds one headless XState machine to an explicit owning project. Publishable projects require a direct package subpath; application projects remain local.

name.description: Machine name without the Machine suffix

project.description: Nx project that owns the machine
project.x-prompt: Which Nx project owns the machine?

subpath.description: Direct singular package subpath; required for publishable projects and forbidden for application-local machines
